Hi Sarah,

Great day here on our block - the flowers you recently got in front yard have blossoming like gang buster. Such an awesome splash o`color - really lures one into smiling!  

Let you enjoy the appreciation for a minute or twos - just wanted you share in my delight in seeing it all in one big display now in peak. 

Went to grab mail, saw that lovely thing. Hope I wasn`t imposing, didn’t mean a step inside if you needed to keep that to just you or a couple folks in the home. Just a casual passer-thong.  

Anyway glad you are sharing the joy! Hope the rest looks beautiful in here, inside the front doors where they aren’t seen as readily.

Best,

Jane
